1.w: Sound the alarm! An eagle looms over the temple of the Lord! For they have broken their covenant with me and have rebelled against my law.

2.w: Israel cries out to me, “My God, we acknowledge you!”

3.w: But Israel has rejected what is morally good; so an enemy will pursue him.

4.w: They enthroned kings without my consent. They appointed princes without my approval. They made idols out of their silver and gold, but they will be destroyed!

5.w: O Samaria, he has rejected your calf idol. My anger burns against them! They will not survive much longer without being punished, even though they are Israelites!

6.w: That idol was made by a workman—it is not God! The calf idol of Samaria will be broken to bits.

7.w: They sow the wind, and so they will reap the whirlwind! The stalk does not have any standing grain; it will not produce any flour. Even if it were to yield grain, foreigners would swallow it all up.

8.w: Israel will be swallowed up among the nations; they will be like a worthless piece of pottery.

9.w: They have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey that wanders off. Ephraim has hired prostitutes as lovers.

10.w: Even though they have hired lovers among the nations, I will soon gather them together for judgment. Then they will begin to waste away under the oppression of a mighty king.

11.w: Although Ephraim has built many altars for sin offerings, these have become altars for sinning.

12.w: I spelled out my law for him in great detail, but they regard it as something totally unknown to them.

13.w: They offer up sacrificial gifts to me and eat the meat, but the Lord does not accept their sacrifices. Soon he will remember their wrongdoing; he will punish their sins, and they will return to Egypt.

14.w: Israel has forgotten his Maker and built royal palaces, and Judah has built many fortified cities. But I will send fire on their cities; it will consume their royal citadels.
